'''Oskara''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] who worked for [[Teemo/Legends|Teemo]] before betraying him and being forced to flee his wrath.

==Biography==
[[File:Oskara-EotE.png|thumb|left|250px|Oskara's favored weapon was her personal autocannon.]]
Oskara was a native of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]]. When her sister, [[Makara]], was captured by [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] thugs to work in the [[Ryll/Legends|Ryll]] [[Spice/Legends|spice]] mines she offered her services to the gang leader as an "experienced [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]]." Her first job went well and she was mentored by [[Gyax]], a veteran hunter. Oskara continued to work for the spice mine gang to keep her sister safe.<ref name="EotEBG" />

The spice gang loaned her out to [[Teemo/Legends|Teemo]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] and although Teemo paid her well she learned that Teemo was planning on seizing the Ryll spice mine. Fearing for her sister's safety she partnered with the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Gladiator/Legends|gladiator]] [[Lowhhrick/Legends|Lowhhrick]] and the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Pash]] and sent a warning to her compatriots back on Ryloth.<ref name="EotEBG" />

==Personality and traits==
Oskara was [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] with [[Color/Legends|green]] skin. She seemed jaded and cynical due to her rough childhood. She was careful not to get too attached to anything or anyone and focused on her mission instead of emotional entanglements.<ref name="EotEBG" />
